title: At the U.N., Japan’s Leader Says It’s Time to End ‘Enemy State’ Label
summary_full: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said the United Nations should scrub the World War II-era designation from its Charter. China and Russia have used the term recently to attack Japan.
